title: Measured multi-checkpoint C/20 discharge curves for Stanford LG M50T W8
protocol: Periodic C/20 constant-current discharge capacity tests from 100% SOC to 2.5 V.
processing: SOH is each measured C/20 discharge capacity relative to W8 diagnostic 1. SOC is normalized within each measured diagnostic curve. These are quasi-static C/20 discharge-voltage curves; no missing SOH curve is generated by a degradation formula.
